name: ChatGPT & Gemini para WooCommerce
author: Robson Silva Moreira

sections.description:
ChatGPT & Gemini para WooCommerce is an exclusive enterprise-grade bridge connecting your store to the most advanced AI ecosystems, powered by the Gazeta News Guarulhos Technology Group.

Engineered with a proprietary external processing architecture, this solution seamlessly synchronizes your product catalog with global AI networks without exposing your local server to heavy processing loads. We handle the complex data structuring off-site, delivering pure performance to your storefront.

🚀 Enterprise Capabilities:

  • 🧠 Omnichannel AI Synchronization: Connect your store’s database directly to the neural networks of Google Gemini, OpenAI (ChatGPT), and Meta Commerce.
  • ⚡ Zero-Impact Cloud Performance: Our external Edge architecture handles the heavy lifting. Generate massive dynamic synchronizations while your WordPress server memory remains at 100% capacity.
  • 📈 Algorithmic SEO Booster: Automated semantic structuring designed to dominate organic search engines and generative AI discovery tools.
  • 🛡️ Military-Grade Security: Audited infrastructure with strict adherence to data protection standards and WordPress core compliance. No data leaks, no server crashes.

Stop relying on basic plugins that slow down your store. Upgrade your WooCommerce to the AI era with the GNG Enterprise Ecosystem.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/gng-ecosystem-seo-cache-ai-feeds directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to the GNG Ecosystem settings panel to configure your feed preferences.
  4. Add the shortcode [gngeco_selo_confianca] to your pages to display the trust badge.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin overload my server?

No. It is specifically engineered to generate feeds efficiently, minimizing database queries and memory usage.

Do I need a Cloudflare account?

While highly recommended for maximum Edge performance and security, it is not strictly required for basic feed generation.
